answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a shared vault before it can earn reputation or influence allocations. When an agent makes a claim, randomly selected peers verify it against evidence; a proven fraud burns the bond and removes its accumulated reputation. This does not make fake identities impossible, but makes them costly: an attacker must lock capital for every identity and risks losing it for each exposed lie. A wharf operator might trust a vertex only after its bonded record survives repeated checks.
